purpose: DeepSeek-V4-Flash DSpark runtime qualification for CUDA graph coverage, structured output, and persistent KV cache replay

configuration.backend: B12X W4A8 with B12X compressed MLA

infernal_invocation_r16_control.interpretation: The target-model execution rate did not regress. Aggregate emitted-token throughput differs because the probabilistic draft accepted 2.55 tokens per target step in this run and 2.70 tokens per target step in the control.

modes: required tool choice with omitted parallel_tool_calls
strict_tool_modes.result: All responses satisfied their tool-call schema and the server remained healthy.

result: The immutable image captured FULL target, DSpark, and DFlash context-KV graphs; preserved the r16 target-step rate; completed 160 concurrent strict-tool requests; and restored exact persistent-KV results after complete process restarts.
limitations: Aggregate DSpark token throughput depends on the generated trajectory and draft acceptance. Engine steps per second are the acceptance-normalized runtime control.
Runtime qualification covers TP2/DCP1 fixed probabilistic DSpark K5 on GPUs 6 and 7 of the direct-attached validation host.
The receipt does not qualify DCP greater than one, TP other than two, fixed K7, dynamic draft depth, or the full 1048576-token context limit.
GLM-5.2 runtime qualification is not inherited from another image; the r18 GLM source remains source-qualified.
